section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the relationship between intelligence and creativity, focusing on the threshold hypothesis. A single study investigated this relationship using segmented regression analysis in a sample of 297 participants. The study found varying thresholds for measures of creative potential (85 to 120 IQ points) but no threshold for creative achievement, suggesting that higher intelligence consistently benefits creative achievement.
